purpose: Enable bounded placement reconsideration beyond the single nearest pose per shape, without changing the accepted/default board search policy.

implementation.mechanism: Share the existing sorted frontier, rounded-distance buckets and exact face-aware collision predicate. Collect a deterministic prefix of legal poses instead of returning only the first. The legacy single-result entry point uses the same implementation without allocating a result list.
implementation.bounds: Caller-supplied positive maximum returned poses and maximum visited frontier nodes. Budget exhaustion and complete traversal are distinct result fields. No partial, not-yet-ordered distance bucket is published. The frontier limit does not bound axis-array preparation or wall time.
implementation.validation: New entry point rejects zero limits, nonfinite query coordinates/windows and nonpositive/nonfinite dimensions before search work. Inverted finite windows describe an empty queried domain. Legacy entry-point behavior is preserved.
implementation.accounting: All executed precision operations, including abandoned frontier work, remain in invocation-owned receipts. Candidate metadata counts actual visited frontier nodes. No occupancy or retained incumbent is mutated.

independent_tests.oracle: Full Cartesian grid enumeration using exhaustive rather than hashed collision checks, sorted by rounded distance/x/y; compare every returned pose against the oracle prefix.
independent_tests.coverage: Two grid steps, three face masks, three anchors, three result caps and three frontier budgets; opposite-face child geometry and halos; exact instrumented scalar calls; legacy single-result receipt/pose equivalence; empty domains; invalid anchors and zero limits; partially explored blocked domains versus completely exhausted blocked domains.
independent_tests.greedy_trap_witness: On a 10x4 test board, a 2x2 group's nearest pose blocks a 6x4 group constrained to the left edge. Enumerating the small group's legal alternatives recovers a legal two-group arrangement with the same dimensions and collision predicates. Every branch works on a copy; original occupancy remains empty.

limits_and_next_step: This is a tested search primitive, not a claim of a smaller or faster carrier. Current board policies remain nearest-only. Next integrate bounded alternative incoming poses into failure-directed carrier reconsideration, preserving complete incumbents, rollback and all retry/budget receipts; qualify any successful candidate through existing gates. No new renders, full board qualification, routing or fabrication-readiness claim. Overall goal remains incomplete.
